learning_extracted: The MECH-122 content-packaging build (ree-v3 a7d36429fd) is not inert -- it fires every cycle in every cell (mean_spindle_selection_applied=1.0 throughout) and its blend arithmetic is correct and independently contract-tested. This is new information 861's autopsy could not have had (861 predates the build).

The build's novelty reference is structurally decoupled from the manipulation this experiment family varies: ThetaBuffer.consolidation_summary() averages the same short recent window that also supplies the schema-installation prototypes, so 'novelty relative to it' collapses toward ~0 almost independent of arm -- confirmed both by the uniformly tiny/flat selection_weight and by direct code trace (theta_buffer_size=10, ree_core/utils/config.py:2387).

On the two well-formed seeds (42, 456), touched-slot diversity now moves in the WRONG direction (monotonically decreasing with MEL) rather than merely failing to move -- near-total homogenization (tiny selection weight everywhere) appears to interact with which slots get touched more in higher-shift-rate arms; noted but not fully explained, does not change the repair recommendation.

Seed 123's touched-slot statistic is separately degenerate (4-6/6 cycles insufficient in every arm), independent of the reference-source finding, and produced this run's one spurious C2 pass via a no-data (0.0) fallback comparison rather than a genuine effect.
